info.description: Local-only control-plane API for the Griffino daemon. The API binds to 127.0.0.1:7070 and is consumed by the embedded web console. All non-public endpoints require a bearer session token obtained from POST /auth/login.
info.title: Griffino API

parameters.description: Action payload (passed through to the plugin)
parameters.name: payload

get.summary: Get plugin admin config schema and values

parameters.description: config map and action (save | save_and_start | save_and_restart)
parameters.name: body

parameters.description: config values keyed by schema key
parameters.name: body

parameters.description: username (optional, defaults to admin) and password
parameters.name: body

interfaceRef.description:
InterfaceRef is the provider's standard interface (e.g.
"griffino.interfaces.ai.chat@1.0.0"), filled server-side from the provider's
manifest. Providers are treated as interchangeable only when their interface
major versions are compatible / provider 的标准接口，用于互换前的主版本兼容校验.

x-enum-comments.StatusPendingSetup: Manifest downloaded, config not yet done / 元文件已下载，未完成配置
x-enum-comments.StatusPulling: Pulling images / 正在拉取镜像
x-enum-comments.StatusReady: Config done, never started / 配置完成，从未启动
x-enum-comments.StatusStarting: Images ready, container starting / 镜像就绪，容器启动中

lockoutDurationMinutes.description: LockoutDurationMinutes is how long the account is locked after too many failures (default 15).

maxLoginAttempts.description: MaxLoginAttempts is the number of consecutive failures before lockout (default 5).

sessionTtlHours.description: SessionTTLHours is how long a session token stays valid (default 168 = 7 days).

pluginId.description: "__builtin__" for built-in nodes / 表示内置节点

requestTopicPattern.description: Built-in nodes reuse this for expressions/variable declarations / 内置节点复用此字段存表达式/变量声明

activeNodes.description:
ActiveNodes: in-flight plugin node → its reply deadline. Replaces the old single Deadline;
in parallel, multiple in-flight nodes can coexist. The watchdog scans this table, marking the Task as timed out if any entry expires / 在途插件节点及其回复截止时间

context.description: Pipeline accumulated variables, merged after each step (concurrent writes: last-write-wins) / 流水线累积变量

currentNodeId.description: Most recently advanced node (best-effort, observation-only; not unique in parallel) / 最近推进到的节点

joinState.description:
JoinState: join node ID → current arrival count. Resets to 0 when arrivals reach the static in-degree,
supporting join re-entry inside loops / join 节点 ID → 当前已到达的分支数

loopState.description: key: nodeId, value: current iteration count / 当前迭代次数

triggerPluginId.description: Triggering plugin ID, used for callbacks / 触发方插件 ID，用于回调

pluginId.description: Empty means any source / 为空表示任意来源

BearerAuth.description: Session token issued by POST /auth/login, sent as "Bearer <token>".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
